summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals and updates, including the integration work with Spark and the management of credentials in the REST catalog. Notable topics include the addition of relative paths to the v4 spec and the introduction of finer-grained read restrictions.
highlights: Consensus on 'Complete' representation for partial updates
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on credential management for KMS/Vault
